# CANDIDATE: MIDDAY_RIBBON_FLATTEN_VWAP_REVERSAL

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When the EMA ribbon compresses after a trend and price approaches VWAP from the opposite side, a mean-reversion bounce is likely. This edge exists because ribbon compression indicates reduced momentum and equilibrium, while VWAP acts as a fair-value magnet; price reverting to VWAP after an extended move captures short-term mean reversion in intraday trends.

## Mechanism

Entry: If ribbon width (8EMA − 55EMA) < 0.1 × ATR(14) AND price has crossed VWAP in the direction opposite to the prior 20-bar 55EMA slope (determined by sign of slope) AND the candle body > 60% of its range, enter at the bar's close in the direction opposite to the prior trend. Stop: opposite side of ribbon width (if prior trend up, stop below 8EMA). Target: VWAP or 1R, whichever is nearer. Exit: Chart-stop at ribbon-width stop; primary target at VWAP; if price reaches 0.5R, move stop to break-even and trail 12% away from extreme-price-since-entry. Regime: Only active 10:30-14:00 ET when VIX is 14-25 and 55EMA slope ≠ 0; avoid low-volume lunch lull and major news.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account ≈ 14% of headline P&L (scaling linear with capital).  
2. **Sample bias:** Zero-sample idea stage; no historical data reviewed; high overfit risk until Stage-1 backtest validates signal frequency and win rate.  
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no walk-forward or held-out window tested).  
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (no realistic OPRA slippage/spread validation on top 3 J days).  
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: whipsaw during VIX expansion (>30) triggering false compression signals; max drawdown scenario: consecutive losses during low-VIX (<12) trending markets where ribbon compression fails; blow-up: volatility expansion causing stops to hit before VAP reversion.  
6. **Concentration:** Unknown until backtest; concentration disclosure requires P&L distribution analysis post-Stage-1.
